var $screen = screen(4,0)
var $display = screen(1,0)
var $ppl = 0


var $xmax = 0.3874
var $xmin = -0.3367

var $ymax = -2.819
var $ymin = -3.564492

var $size = 400

;pitch and roll.
var $y = 0
var $x = 0
var $p = 0
var $r = 0

include  "MAGIC.main.xc"
include  "song.xc"


timer frequency 5
	$display.blank(color(0,0,0,0))
		


update

	$ppl = input_number(10,1) > 390;
	$x = input_number(10,5)
	;var $y = input_number(10,6) ; Actually this is Z, but the sensor is upside down.
	$y = input_number(10,7)
	
	$p = (($y-$ymin) / ($ymax-$ymin)) * 2 -1
	$r = (($x-$xmin) / ($xmax-$xmin)) * 2 -1

	;deadzone.	
	if(abs($p) < 0.2)
		$p = 0
		
	if(abs($r) < 0.2)
		$r = 0
	
	
	var $xpos = $size- $size *  ($x-$xmin) / ($xmax-$xmin);
	var $ypos = $size * ($y-$ymin) / ($ymax-$ymin) ;
	$screen.blank()
	$screen.write($xpos*2,150,yellow,"X")
	$screen.write($xpos*2,$ypos*2,yellow,"Y")
	
	
	$screen.write(195*2,195*2,yellow,"[]")
	


	;$screen.write(200,190,blue,text("x = {}",$x))
	;$screen.write(200,200,green,text("y = {}",$y))
;	$screen.write(200,210,red,text("z = {}",$z))
	
	print("-----------")
	print(text("x = {}, xpos= {}",$x,$xpos))
	print(text("y = {}",$y))
	print(text("roll = {}, pitch= {} ",$r,$p))
	print("-----------")

var $NotesOctave_10 = "";
var $NotesDurations = "";
	
function @GetNoteRaw($note:text, $octave:number) : number
	return $NotesOctave_10.$note / (2^(10-$octave))
	
;;Returns the last character of the string.
function @GetDuration($note:text) : text
	return substring($note,size($note)-1,1)
	
function @GetNote($note: text) : number
	var $octave =0
	var $base = "C"
	;C4W single character note.
	if(size($note) == 3)
		$octave= $note.1:number
		$base = substring($note,0,1)
	;Cs4W double character note.
	else
		$octave= $note.2:number
		$base = substring($note,0,2)
	return @GetNoteRaw($base,$octave)
